title: ImbalancE: Inference-Time Latent Search Against Degree Imbalance in Link Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2609.36996v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Knowledge Graph Embedding models have been extensively used to learn representations of entities and relations in Knowledge Graphs for predicting missing links. However, the quality of the learned representations varies a lot across different areas of the graph. If previous research has loosely linked the problem to relation types or degree bias, we show that it is more widespread and it correlates with the degree imbalance of the entities in test triples. In particular, the prediction of a target entity that has a degree much smaller than the degree of the anchor entity is extremely problematic. This is critical in recommender systems and other use cases, where these triples represent important corner cases. To address this issue, we propose an inference-time latent search optimization method capable of significantly improving model predictions on the most imbalanced triples. translated_title: ImbalancE：推理时潜在搜索应对链接预测中的度不平衡问题
translated_abstract: 知识图谱嵌入模型已被广泛用于学习知识图谱中实体和关系的表示，以预测缺失的链接。然而，学习到的表示的质量在图的不同区域之间差异很大。尽管以往的研究粗略地将该问题与关系类型或度偏差联系起来，我们证明该问题更为普遍，且它与测试三元组中实体的度不平衡相关。特别是，当目标实体的度远小于锚实体的度时，对其的预测极具挑战性。这在推荐系统及其他应用场景中至关重要，因为这些三元组代表了重要的边界情况。为解决该问题，我们提出了一种推理时的潜在搜索优化方法，能够显著改善模型在最不平衡三元组上的预测表现。该方法构建于预训练模型之上，通过探索嵌入空间（摘要在此处被截断）……
tldr: 提出了ImbalancE方法，一种基于预训练模型的推理时潜在搜索优化技术，显著改善了链接预测中因实体度不平衡（目标实体度远小于锚实体度）而导致的预测困难问题。
en_tdlr: We propose ImbalancE, an inference-time latent search optimization method built on pre-trained models that significantly improves link prediction on highly imbalanced triples where the target entity's degree is much smaller than the anchor entity's.
